title: GDAL SQL with lazysf
text: lazysf translates dplyr verbs SQL executes via GDAL. SQL dialect determines ’s possible — lazysf defaults SQLITE, capable option. GDAL provides two SQL dialects querying vector data: SQLITE: full SQLite engine embedded GDAL. Supports subqueries, GROUP , ORDER , CAST, spatial SQL functions. Available format — GDAL runs SQLite -process even Shapefiles. OGRSQL: GDAL’s native SQL engine. Simpler, format-specific features like %LIKE%, subquery support.

title: GDAL SQL with lazysf

title: GDAL SQL with lazysf
text: OGRSQL simpler format-specific features. Set explicitly: OGRSQL limitations dbplyr: subqueries: Operations like rename(), transmute(), chained verbs dbplyr wraps subqueries fail. GROUP subqueries: Simple aggregations may work, complex ones won’t. Use OGRSQL need format-specific features working data source SQLITE dialect isn’t available.
code: lf_ogr <- lazysf(f, dialect = "OGRSQL")  ## Basic filter/select work lf_ogr |>   filter(AREA < 0.1) |>   select(NAME, AREA) |>   collect()

title: GDAL SQL with lazysf
text: things know working GDAL’s SQL engine: FID sticky. GDAL always includes feature ID results, like sf’s sticky geometry column. SQL might select two columns ’ll get three back. Table-qualified wildcards. dbplyr generates SELECT "nc".*, GDAL returns column names prefixed table name (nc.AREA, nc.NAME). lazysf strips prefixes automatically. window functions. RANK(), ROW_NUMBER(), DENSE_RANK() etc. available. means slice_min(), slice_max(), slice_head() won’t work. Use arrange() |> head() instead.
code: ## This won't work: lf |> slice_min(AREA, n = 5)  ## Do this instead: lf |> arrange(AREA) |> head(5) |> collect()

title: GDAL SQL with lazysf
text: large datasets, Arrow C stream interface provides columnar data transfer GDAL, can significantly faster default row-based fetch(): uses GDALVector$getArrowStream() via nanoarrow. Data moves GDAL R batches 65,536 features without going OGRFeature abstraction. Requires GDAL >= 3.6 nanoarrow package. Arrow path produces identical results default path — column names, geometry handling, wk type marking.
code: lf <- lazysf(f, use_arrow = TRUE) d <- lf |> collect()

title: GDAL SQL with lazysf
text: lazysf can return geometry several formats: geometry columns marked wk types (wk::wkb, wk::wkt, wk::rct) interoperate wk ecosystem. convert sf data frame, collect first call sf::st_as_sf():
code: ## WKB (default) — compact binary, interoperable with sf and wk lazysf(f, geom_format = "WKB")  ## WKT — human-readable text lazysf(f, geom_format = "WKT")  ## BBOX — bounding box per feature (fast, no full geometry) lazysf(f, geom_format = "BBOX")  ## NONE — no geometry at all (fastest for attribute-only queries) lazysf(f, geom_format = "NONE") lazysf(f) |> collect() |> sf::st_as_sf()

title: GDAL SQL with lazysf
text: lazysf respects options defaults: lazysf.dialect: default SQL dialect (default: "SQLITE") lazysf.geom_format: default geometry format (default: "WKB") lazysf.use_arrow: default Arrow stream setting (default: FALSE) lazysf.query.debug: TRUE, print SQL row counts every query
code: options(lazysf.query.debug = TRUE) lazysf(f) |> filter(AREA < 0.1) |> collect() ## prints: SQL and row counts for each query dbplyr issues

title: Delayed Read for GDAL Vector Data Sources
text: window functions: slice_min(), slice_max(), row_number() etc. supported GDAL’s SQLite engine. OGRSQL dialect: support subqueries, complex dplyr verb chains may fail. Use SQLITE dialect (default) instead. FID sticky: GDAL always includes feature ID column results, even SQL doesn’t select . Format-dependent: Performance capability varies GDAL driver. File formats like Shapefile GeoPackage work well; text formats like CSV GeoJSON slower large data.

title: lazysf 0.4.0
text: backend now uses gdalraster GDAL access. Geometry columns collected results wk-typed (wk::wkb, wk::wkt, wk::rct). st_as_sf() longer registered tbl_GDALVectorConnection. Use collect() first, sf::st_as_sf() resulting tibble. DBI class names renamed: SFSQLConnection → GDALVectorConnection, SFSQLDriver → GDALVectorDriver, SFSQLResult → GDALVectorResult. driver constructor now GDALSQL() (SFSQL()). magrittr pipe (%>%) longer re-exported. Use R’s native pipe (|>).

title: lazysf 0.4.0
text: sql_translation(), sql_escape_logical(), sql_query_fields() now dispatch custom dialect class (sql_dialect_gdal_vector / sql_dialect_gdal_sqlite) rather connection class, matching dbplyr 2.6.0 dispatches generics. Identifier quoting now uses double quotes (ANSI SQL) rather backticks. GDAL’s embedded SQLite engine rejects backtick-quoted identifiers generated dbplyr 2.6.0’s default SQLite dialect. supports_window_clause() removed dbplyr 2.6.0; now conditionally registered generic exists. Spatial SQL translations (SpatiaLite functions) gated dialect: SQLITE connections get full spatial translations, OGRSQL connections get base translations .

title: lazysf 0.4.0
text: New geom_format argument dbConnect() controls geometry output: "WKB" (default), "WKT", "NONE", "BBOX". Configurable globally via options(lazysf.geom_format = ...). New dialect argument dbConnect() controls SQL dialect: "SQLITE" (default), "OGRSQL", "INDIRECT_SQLITE", "" (let GDAL choose). SQLITE default supports subqueries (required dbplyr verb chaining) spatial SQL functions like ST_Area(). Configurable globally via options(lazysf.dialect = ...). lazysf() now passes ... dbConnect(), geom_format dialect can set directly: lazysf(dsn, geom_format = "WKT"). Added db_connection_describe() method informative printing: GDAL <SQLITE> WKB [/path//file.gpkg]. New sql_query_fields() method generates LIMIT 0 SQL field discovery (replacing dbplyr’s default (0 = 1) OGRSQL can’t handle). named tables, dbSendQuery() intercepts uses $getLayerDefn() pure OGR metadata access — SQL execution . Subqueries correctly wrapped parentheses alias. New .schema_from_defn() builds typed empty data frames OGR layer definitions, mapping OGR field types R types (OFTInteger → integer, OFTReal → double, OFTDateTime → POSIXct, OFSTBoolean → logical, etc.). Schema column names types match fetch() returns. New dbListFields() method uses $getLayerDefn() schema introspection without executing SQL. Geometry columns now automatically marked wk types materialization: wk::wkb() WKB, wk::wkt() WKT, wk::rct() BBOX. CRS layer’s spatial reference attached geometry vectors. New sql_translation() method provides SpatiaLite function translations SQLITE dialect. R functions like st_area(), st_intersects(), st_buffer(), st_transform() etc. translate SpatiaLite SQL equivalents, enabling idiomatic dplyr pipelines spatial operations: lazysf("countries.gpkg") |> filter(st_area(geom) > 1e6). OGRSQL dialect falls back base SQLite translations . Added sql_escape_logical() method: TRUE/FALSE map 1/0 SQLite, NA maps NULL. Added supports_window_clause() method (returns TRUE SQLITE dialect). Future-proofed upcoming dbplyr sql_dialect() generic. next version dbplyr ships new dialect system, lazysf automatically provide SQLite translation without code changes. New use_arrow argument dbConnect() lazysf() enables GDAL’s Arrow C stream interface reading features. Columnar transfer via GDALVector$getArrowStream() nanoarrow, typically much faster larger datasets. Requires GDAL >= 3.6. Configurable globally via options(lazysf.use_arrow = ...). Geometry columns automatically marked wk types materialization. CRS attached. enables sf::st_as_sf() collected tibble via sf’s wk support without lazysf-specific method.

title: lazysf 0.4.0
text: Multiline SQL dbplyr now collapsed single line passing GDALVector. GDAL’s constructor rejects SQL newline characters, dbplyr generates rename(), transmute(), verb enumerates columns explicitly. Table-qualified column prefixes GDAL (e.g. nc.AREA SELECT "nc".*) now stripped automatically column names match dbplyr expects. OGRFeatureSet class stripped fetch results. gdalraster print method class conflicts wk-typed geometry columns. FID column name normalized uppercase "FID" fetch() Arrow paths, matching GDAL’s behavior (GeoPackage stores "fid" fetch() returns "FID"). Geometry column getLayerDefn() excluded attribute field loop .schema_from_defn() — getLayerDefn() includes geometry field fetch() handles separately via returnGeomAs.

title: lazysf 0.4.0
text: GDAL’s GDALVector initialization emits “SpatiaLite available” warnings systems without SpatiaLite linked. harmless C++ diagnostics can’t suppressed R. Tracked upstream gdalraster. window functions: slice_min(), slice_max(), row_number() etc. supported GDAL’s SQLite engine. Use arrange() |> head() instead. Spatial SQL function availability depends GDAL build configuration. ST_Area() ST_SRID() work without SpatiaLite (GDAL-native). ST_AsText(), ST_Intersects(), geometry operations require SpatiaLite.

title: lazysf 0.4.0
text: gdalraster (>= 2.0.0) replaces sf Imports. wk added Imports geometry type marking. sf removed dependencies (previously Imports, Suggests). nanoarrow added Suggests (Arrow stream interface). dbplyr (>= 2.0.0) now required (2nd edition backend API). magrittr removed dependencies.
